bullets.text: Rachel Moreno, VP Operations at Acme Logistics, inbound via the website form about shipment delay analytics.
Acme moves about 11,000 shipments a week of regional freight across the Midwest and Southeast.
Data lives in Snowflake (TMS events, warehouse scans, carrier API feeds) with Looker on top; the data team is two people led by Tariq.
On-time rate fell from 94% to about 87% over two quarters, and the team cannot prove why (carrier capacity vs. the Memphis warehouse).
Ops questions go into a ticket queue with a ~6 business day turnaround: 'like getting a weather report for last week'.

Looker on Snowflake at ~$45K/yr; contract ends January 31.
